messages:
eva: Heads-up — onboarding request for opt-llama3-13b-v2 weights + tokenizer. Partner dropped a tarball to an external S3 link. Size ~13GB, format: pytorch, quant-ready (we got an 8-bit dump). License says 'custom-noncommercial'. Need a quick provenance/registry checklist before we ingest into model-store.

tj: OK. Can you paste the S3 path + checksums and any model_card or README? We need sha256, file size, and explicit tokenizer files (tokenizer.json/vocab/merges or spm) confirmed. Also need the config.json.

eva: s3://partner-bucket/llama3/opt-llama3-13b-v2.tar.gz
sha256: f2b3c9d5b1a8a2d8b4f3e6a1c7d9e5a6b0a1c2d3e4f5a6b7c8d9e0f1a2b3c4d5
size: 13984752128
includes: model.pt, config.json, tokenizer.json, merges.txt, spm.model, model-card.md

mina: quick checklist I run locally: 1) download and checksum verify 2) open config.json to ensure arch matches our runtime 3) tokenizer sanity (vocab size + special tokens) 4) run small forward check (1-2 tokens) 5) try a conversion-to-8bit path if needed.

raj: license flag: 'custom-noncommercial' — legal needs to review before we make this available on hosted. For Dedicated/Private it's usually fine but must be marked restricted in registry.

mina: adding quant/quality tasks: put in quant queue for 4-bit PTQ and mixed-int8 experiments. Eval targets: LM perplexity on wiki40b, codebench small, chat-safety quick-run. Also run our prompt-suite for instruction following.

TJ: pinging on config.json — can you paste the model config snippet? we need num_hidden_layers, hidden_size, kv_cache layout. If config mismatches our kernel choices we'll need a mapping.

eva: config.json excerpt: {
  "model_type": "llama",
  "hidden_size": 8192,
  "num_hidden_layers": 40,
  "intermediate_size": 27648,
  "rotary_dim": 64
}

mina: perfect. Rotor dims look normal. For tokenizer: tokenizer.json + spm.model both present — good.

TJ: commands we run to verify checksum and quick forward:```
# verify
openssl dgst -sha256 opt-llama3-13b-v2.tar.gz
# quick smoke run (inside env)
python -c "from transformers import AutoModel; m=AutoModel.from_pretrained('./unpacked'); print(m.config.hidden_size)"
```

ingest-bot: Intake form created: https://redwood.infra/models/intake/1742507890 — please fill in license review state, ingestion owner, and tag (experimental/partner). Will auto-create registry entry in staging once checks pass.

raj: legal: please set license_review=pending and do not add to public-hosted catalog until sign-off. Also add a note on allowed_usage.

mina: for eval metrics and regressions, adding a baseline run using our Llama-13b reference config so we can compare perplexity and instruction-following. If quantization regresses >5% on instruction score, we block auto-swap.

TJ: storage/registry metadata we require: provenance_url (S3), checksum_sha256, uploader identity (partner name + contact), license_text or link, model_card text, tokenizer_files list, recommended_quant_profiles (e.g., 4bit-ptq, awq). Example registry API:```
curl -X POST https://registry.internal/api/models \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -d '{"name":"opt-llama3-13b-v2","version":"2025-03-01","provenance":"s3://partner-bucket/llama3/opt-llama3-13b-v2.tar.gz","checksum":"f2b3...c4d5","license":"custom-noncommercial","tags":["partner","experimental"]}'
```

eva: I'll upload the unpacked files to our staging-store and run the checksum/forward smoke. ETA 2 hours.

mina: once in staging, I'll queue quant runs and the eval harness. Will post signal if instruction-following drops.

raj: I'll loop in legal on the doc. Also, mark registry entry as access:restricted and visibility:private by default.

TJ: thanks — once legal clears we'll promote to 'staging-available' and spin up a canary in Dedicated for perf profiling. :thumbsup:

ingest-bot: Registry entry created (staging): model_id=mdl_20250301_0953, status=provisioned-staging. Refer to intake form for next steps.

eva: noted — updating intake form with partner contact and license PDF.

mina: quick note for posterity: when ingesting partner weights we always extract and store: model.pt (original), model_quant_candidates/ (our quant outputs), tokenizer/ (original tokenizer files), model-card.md, provenance.json (automatically generated with checksums + upload audit).

tj: perfect. closing this thread after ingestion and first evals. Thanks all. :rocket:
